purpose: Single-shot retrieval surface for the Eclipse-Omega claim-sieve research line. Findings remain subordinate to their paired operation, machine receipt, executable test, and source evidence.
main_finding_plain_language: The flattened and role-typed paths made the same accept/reject decisions, but the role-typed path retained enough intermediate structure to localize which boundary failed. The demonstrated contribution is diagnostic resolution, not improved terminal classification.

findings.result: Several universal Eclipse-Omega claims were demoted or rejected under type checking and hostile alternatives. S != O != E survives as typed forensic accounting; zero registered events do not identify hidden interaction; monotone narrowing is not universal; moire remains analogy absent operator fidelity.
Retrieval-observability deficit does not universally force semantic redundancy upward; ranking policy and diversity control can reverse the direction under the same capacity reduction.
A shared arrow glyph does not identify operator type. Exact stage composition can preserve terminal behavior while stage-local witnesses preserve diagnostic localization.

Four implemented A15-R0 boundaries were scored source-bound. Three earned bounded stage value; the typed-deficit classifier to audit wrapper lost independent scientific-operator status while remaining useful receipt scaffolding.

Boundary value must be role-typed. Flow-Core retained governance/type-safety, projection/data-minimization, diagnostic-localization, and integrity/formal-invariant value while promoting zero scientific epistemic operators.

Three hostile cross-family worlds collapse to the same terminal HOLD while role-typed boundaries recover three distinct causes: Flow-Core authority breach, Flow-Core-to-Aperture reference mismatch, and Aperture jurisdiction breach. Reference consistency adds adjudication value without establishing truth.

On five defect families excluded from v0.10 plus one valid control, terminal-only and role-typed paths both achieved 1.0 accept/reject accuracy. Defect localization separated 0.0 terminal-only versus 1.0 role-typed. The replay case uses real post-digest receipt tamper rather than a mocked replay failure.

After freezing the role-typed adjudicator before preregistration and authoring the evaluator only afterward, 72 preregistered authored instances preserved binary parity and localization separation: both paths 72/72 binary correct; terminal-only 0/60 localization; role-typed 60/60 localization. The demonstrated contribution remains diagnostic resolution rather than terminal decision gain.
findings.critical_caveat: The 12 repetitions per condition are deterministic variations of six authored recipe families. Row-level Wilson intervals are descriptive and do not authorize iid population-confidence claims; recipe family is the primary independence unit.
findings.next_test: Use multiple structurally distinct mutation recipes per stage, unseen defect subtypes, and multi-defect collisions; score hierarchical stage localization separately from exact-subtype localization under leave-one-recipe-family-out evaluation, treating recipe family rather than row count as the primary independence unit.
